Tip Log - The Smart Tip Tracker & Income Tracker for Service Professionals

Take control of your income with Tip Log, the simple, powerful tip tracking app built for servers, baristas, delivery drivers, salon staff, and anyone who earns tips. Log your shifts, tips, and true hourly pay with the most flexible tip tracker designed for real life in hospitality and service.

Whether you’re logging cash and card tips, calculating tip-outs, or comparing earnings across jobs, Tip Log gives you the clarity you need. This all-in-one server tip tracker helps you understand your real income, set goals, and make smarter scheduling decisions. No spreadsheets. No guesswork. Just clean records, clear insights, and confidence in every shift.

Life in hospitality moves fast - sections change, side work piles up, and no two shifts are ever the same. With Tip Log’s tip tracking system, you’ll never lose sight of your income again. Capture cash tips, credit tips, and tip-outs instantly, and see how weather, day of week, or special events affect your earnings. Paper notes get lost, memory fades but Tip Log’s tip tracker keeps your records safe, searchable, and accurate.

Who Tip Log Is For
Servers & Waitstaff looking for a reliable server tip tracker
Baristas tracking daily earnings
Delivery Drivers & Couriers who need precise income tracking
Salon & Spa Professionals recording commissions and tips
Valets, Bellhops & Hotel Staff managing multiple income sources
Anyone with variable, tipped income needing a simple tip tracking app
If your income depends on tips, Tip Log is your personal tip tracker, keeping you organized, informed, and ready for anything.

Key Capabilities At A Glance:
Quick, customizable shift entry
Cash tips and credit tips tracked separately
Hours, and true hourly rate calculations
Tip outs, and deductions
Sales totals & covers
Multiple jobs tracking
Powerful filters and date ranges
Clear, useful summaries and trends
Notes & pictures for context that explain the “why”
Data export for budgeting or taxes
Private, reliable, and built for speed

Keeping a consistent tip log supports accurate tax reporting and helps you understand what portion of your income comes from cash vs. non-cash tips. A dependable income tracker reduces headaches at tax time and helps you verify payroll or tip-pool distributions with confidence.

Your earnings are personal. Tip Log is built with privacy and respect for your data in mind. Your logs are yours, and you control what you share and when. Keep your information organized without giving it up to a dozen different tools or random spreadsheets.

Contact Us
If you have any questions, feedback, or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our support team at hussain@hussainmustafa.com. We're here to help you make the most out of Tip Log.

Disclaimer
Tip Log is a personal finance and record-keeping tool. It is not a substitute for professional tax, legal, or payroll advice. For specific guidance related to employment, taxes, or tip reporting, consult a qualified professional in your area.
